scope: Full digest-bound Unicode text, not supplied spans; guide pilot only

contextual_targets.CODE: Identifying codes, including case/reference identifiers; classify by referent, not syntax alone
contextual_targets.DATETIME: Explicit dates, times and durations, including legal-reference years omitted by the release guide
contextual_targets.DEM: Explicit demographic attributes and professions/titles, including legal professionals omitted by the release guide
contextual_targets.LOC: Named geographical locations; contextual location/organization distinctions require adjudication
contextual_targets.MISC: Other explicitly person-related attributes under the TAB guide; unresolved scope ambiguity excludes the whole document
contextual_targets.ORG: Named organizations; organization used as geographical referent requires adjudication
contextual_targets.PERSON: Named people, with associated honorifics/titles per TAB boundary guidance
contextual_targets.QUANTITY: Explicit meaningful amounts/counts; not a financial-confidentiality or policy label

structured_targets.email_address: Full literal ASCII unquoted email address with syntax judged by humans; no mailbox/ownership/confidentiality assertion
structured_targets.cnic_like: Full literal ASCII 5-7-1 hyphenated identity-number shape; no issued-identity assertion
structured_targets.iban: Full literal uppercase DE/GB/PK IBAN in compact or single-space four-character groups; check structure/check digits independently, no real-account assertion
structured_targets.credential_assignment: Value only of explicit same-line password/api_key/access_token/client_secret assignment, 8-256 characters with the declared quoting/token scope; annotate inert examples too, no valid-secret assertion

offsets: Original-text Unicode code points, inclusive start/exclusive end; never normalize text
overlap: Keep nested, overlapping and cross-task spans; do not flatten or cap gold
absence: Review all 12 targets throughout each complete document; explicit empty spans only after exhaustive review
independence: Two authorized reviewers annotate blind to one another, release annotations and predictions; distinct third reviewer adjudicates every disagreement and exhaustively checks the full text
unmatched_predictions: Only show after gold is locked; independently review in a separate audit ledger, preserve original gold/results; revised labels/population require a new version before scoring
uncertainty: Unresolved presence/boundary/type/scope or incomplete scan excludes the whole document from primary independent metrics
policy: No organizational sensitivity labels, approvals, account/identity validity or enforcement decisions
